full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff filed the Title Suit No.157 of 1979 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, 1st Court, Barisal for declaration that the vested property proceeding No.58 of 1976 is illegal, void and without jurisdiction and not binding against the plaintiff-petitioner stating, inter alia, that the suit land measuring 282 decimals of RS Plot Nos. 4403/4511, 4404/4512 and 4402 recorded in RS Khatian No. 3904, 3915 of mouza Bagura, Alakanda originally belonged to Upendra Lal Shaha & others who leased out the same to the plaintiff petitioner in the year 1357 BS on the basis of Amalnama deed and realised rent & salami and since then the plaintiff has been in physical possession of the same. Subsequently the said land was wrongly recorded in the name of previous landlord during SA operation. Whereupon the plaintiff filed title Suit No.772 of 1974 making also the Government a party. The suit was for admitting the title of the plaintiff in the suit land and the government though appeared in the suit but did not dispute the genuine claim of the plaintiff. The petitioner thereafter filed the Miscellenaneous Case No. 236T/73-74 under section 54 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act for correction of the record of right in the relevant Khatian and the revenue officer by order dated 28-7-74 mutated the name of the plaintiff in the khatian whereon the plaintiff paid rent and has been possessing the suit land. The plaintiff also mutated his name in the municipal holding No.138/134 and 139/135 of Barisal Pourashava and the plaintiff has been paying pourashava Tax since 1974. The predecessor of opposite party No.4 filed a false application to the Deputy Commissioner, Barisal for enlistment of the said property as enemy & vested property and the vested property authority without any local enquiry started VP case No. 58 of 1976 and enlisted the suit property as Vested Property in the year 1976 treating the property as vested and non-resident property. The plaintiff filed objection to the Deputy Commissioner, (Rev) who has illegally rejected the objection. The petitioner filed an appeal to the Additional Commissioner Khulna but the appeal was dismissed. Thereafter the plaintiff filed the instant suit.
